mycol.edition: MyMahir Malaysia Critical Occupations List (MyCOL) 2024/2025 - 8th edition, 66 critical occupations across 18 sectors
mycol.note: Official TalentCorp source: listed titles come from TalentCorp's MyCOL 2024/2025 brochure, which lists all 66 occupations. The full report (https://www.talentcorp.com.my/images/uploads/publication/204/MyMahir-Malaysia-Critical-Occupations-List-MyCOL20242025-1773385490.pdf) is over 10 MB and could not be fetched, so per-occupation sectors could not be read. A sector is given only where the brochure states 'Top Sectors' (Software Developers). The release date is not stated in the brochure. DOSM's Q2 2026 Job Market Insights (18 Aug 2026) still cites MyCOL 2024/2025, and no newer edition was found. Matches by MASCO description use KESUMA's e-MASCO portal (MASCO 2020): unit group 2512 includes 'IT Systems Architect'; 2519 covers software testers, system testers and QA engineers; 2524 Data Professionals covers data scientists and data analysts; 2531 Cyber Security Professionals covers security analysts and offensive/defensive operations; 2141 Industrial and Production Engineers lists automation, robotics, energy and new-energy engineers; 2152 Electronic Engineers covers circuits and systems used in computing; 3119 Industrial and Production Technicians includes helping test and design robotic equipment; and 2166 Graphic and Multimedia Designers includes e-commerce website designers. Three matches are partial: Business Intelligence Analysts (via data analyst), Solar Energy Systems Engineers (via 'Jurutera Tenaga Baharu', new-energy engineer) and Web and Digital Interface Designers (via e-commerce website designer). These candidate occupations were not matched: Web Developers (MASCO 2513 is not on the list), Computer User Support Specialists, Telecommunications Engineering Specialists (2153 is not listed), Computer and Information Research Scientists, Microsystems Engineers, and Mechatronics Engineers and Electro-Mechanical/Mechatronics Technicians (no explicit MASCO title; the nearest is 2141-01 Automation Engineer). Three were too loose to match: Data Warehousing Specialists (2521 lists database architects only), Validation Engineers ('Engineering Professionals NEC' lists QA/QC and commissioning engineers) and Electrical and Electronics Drafters (examples under 'Draughtspersons and Surveying Technicians' are architectural, civil and survey roles). Software Developers, Information Technology System Administrators and Industrial and Production Engineers have appeared in all eight MyCOL editions since 2015.
